subject: [PATCH 25/60] mm/mempolicy: queue only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages()

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: No review comments have been made by other authors in this thread.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the memory policy by queuing only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages(). The change involves converting ZONE_DEVICE checks to folio_is_common_memory(), ensuring that skipped folios do not count as failures. This modification is intended to optimize memory migration.
